title: Markov Decision Processes
overview: Model sequential decision making under uncertainty with states, actions, transition probabilities, and rewards.
objectives: Define an MDP and a policy

method.title: MDP definition
method.body: An MDP consists of states, actions, transition probabilities P(s'|s,a), rewards, and a discount factor gamma.

method.title: Policies and values
method.body: A policy maps states to actions and its value is the expected discounted sum of rewards.

method.title: Bellman optimality
method.body: V*(s) = max over a of the sum over s' of P(s'|s,a)[R + gamma V*(s')].

method.title: Solving MDPs
method.body: Value iteration and policy iteration compute optimal policies when the model is known.

playground.starterCode:
gamma = 0.9
V = {'A': 0.0, 'B': 0.0}
# A: stay (r=0) or go to B (r=1); B: stay (r=2)
for _ in range(100):
    V['B'] = 2 + gamma * V['B']
    V['A'] = max(0 + gamma * V['A'], 1 + gamma * V['B'])
print({k: round(v, 2) for k, v in V.items()})
